name: Evoker
summary: Explosive elemental magic: free Evocation spells, cantrips that always bite and allies spared from blasts.

feature.name: Evocation Savant
feature.summary: Add two Evocation spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free.
feature.text: Choose two Wizard spells from the Evocation school, each level 2 or lower, and add them to your spellbook for free. Whenever you gain a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one more Evocation Wizard spell of a level you can cast for free.

feature.name: Potent Cantrip
feature.summary: Your damaging cantrips deal half damage on a miss or a successful save.
feature.text: When you cast a cantrip at a creature and miss with the attack roll or the target succeeds on its save, it still takes half the cantrip's damage but no other effect.

feature.name: Sculpt Spells
feature.summary: Choose 1 + spell level creatures to automatically succeed against your Evocation spell and take no damage.

feature.name: Empowered Evocation
feature.summary: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of your Wizard Evocation spells.

feature.name: Overchannel
feature.summary: Deal maximum damage with a level 1-5 damaging spell; repeat uses before a Long Rest cost Necrotic damage.
